author: Chris Schommer
title: Mookie Betts scratched from lineup Wednesday
desc: Mookie Betts has been scratched from the lineup by the Los Angeles Dodgers due to right wrist soreness Wednesday according to Kirsten Watson.
impact: Betts will take a seat on the bench Wednesday night, with Miguel Rojas taking his spot at shortstop against the Athletics Wednesday night.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Will Smith (neck) expected to be out through All-Star break
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts announced that he expects Will Smith to be sidelined until after the All-Star break.
impact: Smith has been on the shelf since June 11th with neck inflammation, and it looks like he will miss at least a few more weeks. The catcher was slashing .249/.338/.382 with six homers in 52 games before his injury. Dalton Rushing will continue to handle most of the catching work as Chuckie Robinson serves as his backup.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Brent Rooker to undergo season-ending knee surgery
desc: Brent Rooker is set to undergo season-ending left knee surgery to address cartilage damage.
impact: Rooker has been on the injured list with a bone bruise since June 12th, but the injury will now require surgery that will end his season. The outfielder slashed .200/.281/.389 with 10 home runs and 29 RBI in 48 games played.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Matt Chapman (abdominal) placed on injured list
desc: Matt Chapman has been placed on the 10-day injured list with an abdominal strain by the San Francisco Giants according to Susan Slusser.
impact: Chapman will look to avoid an extended stay on the injured list after exiting Tuesday night's loss with the injury. In a corresponding move, the Giants recalled Christian Koss from Triple-A Fresno.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Helsley dealing with elbow discomfort
desc: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz said Ryan Helsley was unavailable on Wednesday against the White Sox due to right elbow discomfort.
impact: Helsley had been warming up before he sat down. There should be an update when he is further evaluated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Eric Cerantola optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Royals optioned RHP Eric Cerantola to Triple-A Omaha.
impact: Cerantola will return to Triple-A for a fresh arm.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kris Bubic transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Royals transferred LHP Kris Bubic to the 60-day injured list.
impact: The move opens up a spot on the 40-man roster for Kansas City. There should be an update on Bubic in the coming days.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Connor Seabold (lat) placed on IL
desc: The Royals placed RHP Connor Seabold on the 15-day injured list with a right lat strain.
impact: Seabold left his latest appearance early. He'll be sidelined for at least the next couple of weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Dobnak recalled by Royals
desc: The Royals recalled RHP Randy Dobnak from Triple-A Omaha.
impact: Dobnak will add a fresh arm in the bullpen for Kansas City.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Cuas has contract selected by Royals
desc: The Royals selected the contract of RHP Jose Cuas from Triple-A Omaha.
impact: Cuas will hold a middle-relief role in the Royals bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Grant Holmes could start Thursday
desc: Grant Holmes is a candidate to start Thursday's series finale against the Cardinals.
impact: Holmes was most recently moved to the bullpen as an option. It is expected to be him or Hurston Waldrep taking the mound on Thursday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kai-Wei Teng (knee) placed on IL
desc: The Astros placed RHP Kai-Wei Teng on the 15-day injured list with a right knee sprain.
impact: Teng had been optioned to Triple-A, but he suffered the injury prior to then. He'll likely be sidelined for at least the next few weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cristian Javier to pitch in bullpen when he returns
desc: Astros manager Joe Espada told reporters Cristian Javier will pitch in relief when he returns.
impact: Javier is expected to be activated from the injured list on Friday. He has been sidelined with a Grade 2 shoulder strain since early April.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Connelly Early dealing with posterior left elbow inflammation
desc: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said Connelly Early is dealing with posterior left elbow inflammation.
impact: Early was placed on the injured list following his early exit on Tuesday. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: John Brebbia designated for assignment
desc: The Rockies designated RHP John Brebbia for assignment.
impact: Brebbia is likely to clear waivers.
